The list page has a bug where the initial page load triggers an unnecessary reload.

The load function fires whenever the page state changes. This causes redundant reloads and double renders.

Duplicate page state updates are harmless because React skips re-renders when values match. Pagination errors are acceptable per T11. The FormEvent import needs fixing for Next.js 19. The README will be updated, T11 marked complete, and the build verified with lint and curl tests.

A retry button will be added to the list page for better error handling. Race conditions during pagination are acceptable for T11.
